moments.author: Demis Hassabis
moments.quote: Proposes AI ‘standards body’ modeled on FINRA to test and vet frontier model releases.
moments.why: Cuts to the heart of AI regulation and innovation—huge ripple in tech and policy talk.

moments.author: Demis Hassabis
moments.quote: AI standards body could screen models and slow deployment if risks grow.
moments.why: Broadens the call for public-private regulation—sparks major media and policy debate.

moments.author: Lorde
moments.quote: Fuck the glasses. Don’t get the glasses. Not sexy.
moments.why: High-profile pop star slams Meta’s smart glasses onstage—mashup of culture, privacy, tech.

moments.author: Nick Twork
moments.quote: Those reports are false. The Board did not explore bankruptcy or going‑private. Liquidity sufficient into next year.
moments.why: Lucid pushed back hard after its stock halved—men 25‑45 tracking EV volatility and industry drama.

moments.author: Lucid Group, Inc.
moments.quote: The rumours are completely false…has sufficient liquidity to carry its operations well into next year.
moments.why: Corporate voice calming market chaos after viral bankruptcy rumor; finance and tech bond together.
